findings.location: Poem, stanza beginning “Sometimes I worry and wonder”
findings.source_quote: “Yet the promise remains, all works out well, / For him that in God does delight.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “tutto coopererà al bene” with “tutto finirà per andare bene” to convey the source’s assurance without adding the implication that circumstances actively cooperate toward the good.
findings.translation_quote: “Eppure la promessa resta: tutto coopererà al bene / Di chi si compiace in Dio.”
